definitions: A minor change or action that is likely to lead to a much larger, more serious, or undesirable development.
The beginning of a process or series of events that will gradually become more significant and problematic.
examples: Allowing them to stay out an extra hour is the thin end of the wedge; soon they'll want to stay out all night.
Some argue that this small tax increase is the thin end of the wedge for much higher taxes in the future.
If we give in on this one point, it will be the thin end of the wedge for them to demand more concessions.
lemma: be the thin end of the wedge
source: it's the thin end of the wedge
